login.intro: Log in with your Slimstock account.
login.customerHint: As a customer you don't need a password – you get a personal link to your project.

password.title: Change password
password.rule: At least {{min}} characters. A sentence of several words is easy to remember and secure.
password.firstIntro: You logged in with a start password. Please set your own password now.
password.changed: Password changed. You have to log in again on other devices.

projects.title: Projects
projects.search: Search by project, code or customer …
projects.empty: You are not on any project yet. As soon as someone adds you, it shows up here.
projects.emptyAdmin: No projects yet. Create the first one with “New project”.

project.name: Name
project.languageHint: Default language for everyone on this project; everybody can switch for themselves.
project.planSoon: The project plan with working version, drafts and effort estimation will live here.

members.addRolesIntro: This person is on a parent project. Here you can give them extra roles for “{{project}}” only.
members.name: Name
members.emailHint: The e-mail address lets the app recognise the same person across projects.
members.permissionHint: Usually it follows from the roles. Only adjust if needed.

roles.intro: Project roles describe what someone does on a project. They set the default permission and will be the columns of the effort estimation.
roles.defaultPermissionHint: Applies to everyone with this role unless the project says otherwise.
roles.calculatedLabel: Estimated (own column in the effort estimation)

admin.usersIntro: Slimstock staff with user name and password. Customers don't need an account.
admin.resetIntro: Set a start password and hand it over safely. It has to be changed at the next login; existing sessions end.
admin.resetDone: Done. A new own password has to be chosen at the next login.
admin.usernameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, dot, dash – e.g. anna.berger
admin.startPasswordHint: At least {{min}} characters. Must be changed at the first login.
admin.isAdminLabel: Admin (manage users, roles, customers and all projects)
admin.noCustomers: No customers yet. They are also created together with a project.
